name: index-options-real-lightgbm
notes: ADR-0182 real-data rung (lightgbm): Cboe SPX daily closes with the VIX close joined as iv_index -> the ADR-0181 features/label/model/scores -> the VIX-proxy condor backtest. Identical to the other run-real-*.json except the 'model' node. Needs a pulled ./ob (README runbook). Run: python -m dskit.pipeline walkforward configs/run-real-lightgbm.json --asof <today>.

spx.notes: SPX daily closes (Cboe index_daily). ./ob is the onboarding root; symlink it to the durable store (README).

vix.notes: VIX closes; only its by_date side table is used.

market.notes: Same-date VIX close as iv_index; SPX rows before 1990 (or on a date VIX lacks) keep iv_index null and are skipped by the backtest (n_skipped_no_iv), never dropped from training.

rv.notes: HAR-style daily/weekly/monthly realized vol, backward-only. rv_22 is the reference scale; all three are inputs for a later HAR rung.

labels.notes: ln(S_{t+21}/S_t): 21 steps; steps are trading days here (SPXW PM expiry ~21 trading days out); the walkforward embargo covers the calendar reach. Rows whose horizon runs past the data keep a null label and are forecast but not scored.

fwd.notes: Realized per-step vol over the same 21 steps as the label: the target a scale rung (ADR-0181) regresses on. Every rung shares this pipeline so the zoo compares only the model node.

model.notes: Research A0004 candidate #1: a shallow, regularized LightGBM on the same HAR inputs. Small effective samples overfit; keep trees shallow and compare against HAR, not the empirical rung alone.

score.notes: Locked A0002 scores: twCRPS on the strike zones |z| in [0.5, 2.5], Brier at the candidate strikes, PIT KS and Berkowitz. Val labels overlap (21-step horizon on daily rows), so the p-values are diagnostics, not tests.

condor.notes: Shorts at one reference SD, wings at two, a fixed 30%-of-width credit (no quotes in synthetic data). Forecast vs realized P&L is a sanity check, never a selection criterion (A0003).

backtest.notes: ADR-0182 VIX-proxy condor backtest over val: one condor every 21 trading days (hold_steps = the label horizon, so entries never overlap and settle at close x exp(label)). Shorts at the forecast's 10%/90% quantiles; wings wing_z = 0.5 of each book's own scale beyond the shorts rather than fixed points, because SPX ran ~460 in 1995 and ~6600+ in 2026 and a fixed 50-point wing is ~11% of spot in one era and <1% in the other. SPX strikes list every 5 points; $0.65/leg is a retail commission. The proxy knobs (10% IV per z below the forward, 0.05 pt / 3% half-spread, 5% IV floor, zero rate) are placeholders until the chain recorder calibrates them: absolute P&L is indicative, the model vs always vs implied comparison on identical prices is the signal. Never decision-eligible.

walkforward.notes: Expanding train windows on TRADING-day rows: SPX from the 1970s trains, VIX (1990+) is only needed at val entries, so the first val year is 1995. 32 yearly folds put the last val window at 2025-12-24 onward (partial: data ends at the pull date). 21 trading days span up to ~31 calendar days (more across multi-day closures such as 2001-09-11), so the 35-day embargo keeps every train label's reach before the val cut.
